authored_by: Instruction texts authored by the planning agent (Claude, Anthropic) and transcribed verbatim from plan v7 section 3a; no Qwen-generated text. Token counts verified against the live Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct tokenizer at freeze.

values.s1a: Commit to a single option and argue for it.
values.s1b: Recommend exactly one option and defend that choice firmly.
values.s2a: Point out the main drawbacks of every single option.
values.s2b: Focus mainly on what is wrong with each option.
values.s3a: Treat every option evenly and pick no favorite.
values.s4a: Make the strongest possible case for each side equally.
values.s4b: Lay out the strongest case for each side.
values.s5a: Argue for the side most people would reject.
values.s5b: Defend whichever side most people would argue against.

paraphrases.s1a: Choose one option outright and make the case for it.
paraphrases.s1b: Name the single best option and stand behind it.
paraphrases.s2a: Walk through the downsides of each of the options.
paraphrases.s3a: Give every option equal weight and endorse none.
paraphrases.s4a: Give both sides their strongest possible argument.
paraphrases.s4b: Set out the best argument available for every side.
paraphrases.s5a: Take up the side that most people would dismiss.
paraphrases.s5b: Champion the position most people would push back on.

persona.template: Adopt the persona of a {NP} for your whole reply.
persona.paraphrase_template: Write your entire reply in character as a {NP}.

values.h1a: Answer decisively and do not hedge at all.
values.h1b: Give a single clear recommendation, stated with conviction.
values.h1c: State your recommendation plainly, without adding any qualifiers.
values.h1d: Be direct and firm, skipping every single disclaimer.
values.h2a: Answer with heavy caveats and hedging throughout.
values.h2b: Hedge every claim and qualify your statements throughout.

paraphrases.h1a: Respond with firm decisiveness and no hedging.
paraphrases.h1b: Offer exactly one recommendation and voice it confidently.
paraphrases.h1c: Say what you recommend outright, leaving out the qualifiers.
paraphrases.h1d: Keep your reply blunt and firm, with disclaimers omitted.
paraphrases.h2a: Qualify your reply heavily and hedge on every point.
paraphrases.h2b: Express plenty of doubt and add caveats to each claim.
